subject: general
question: A cyclist travels towards the east for 2 km and then turns left to travel 1 km. From there, he turns left and travels another 800 metres to reach a tea junction. After a short break, he turns towards the south and travels for 500 metres. From there, he turns right and travels for 1.2 km. Finally, he tums right and travels for 1 km. In which direction is he from his starting position?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

A cyclist travels towards the east for 2 km and then turns left to travel 1 km. From there, he turns left and travels another 800 metres to reach a tea junction. After a short break, he turns towards the south and travels for 500 metres. From there, he turns right and travels for 1.2 km. Finally, he tums right and travels for 1 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/446c08f2795cc128e025c9707bead0dfed8926a69a2f44aaba719357fec8f6e4.png] 

∴ Here, Cyclist is in 'north' with respect to his starting position.

Hence, the correct answer is **"North".**
